ops.title: gen-version-xcconfig.sh can be cc-guides-adopted (shared fragment now exists)
ops.body: captain-hook's helper/gen-version-xcconfig.sh is byte-identical to daemonkit's templates/gen-version-xcconfig.sh, which was centralized 2026-07-19 as the cc-skills shared fragment cc-skills:gen-version-xcconfig (plugin/guides/sh/gen-version-xcconfig.sh, POSIX #!/bin/sh, no tokens — no pipes so pipefail-drop is a no-op). To adopt: add .claude/fragments/helper/gen-version-xcconfig.sh/layout.toml with fragments=["cc-skills:gen-version-xcconfig"] + [sources.cc-skills] source="github:yasyf/cc-skills@main", rm the hand-written helper/gen-version-xcconfig.sh, full cc-guides render, cc-guides check, ship (fragment+artifact in one commit). Deferred this session (captain-hook working copy owned by track-k); daemonkit+fusekit already adopted. No ulimit in this script, so the dash -u/-p gotcha does not apply here.
